title: Dental PPO Plans Service Class Schedule
content:
Each of the Dental PPO Plans assigns every Cascade benefit category to a service class: preventive, basic or major, or not covered. The service class decides which coinsurance percentage, waiting period and deductible treatment apply to a line.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Oral evaluation (exam) | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive |
| Cleaning (prophylaxis) | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive |
| Bitewing x-rays | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive |
| Full-mouth series or panoramic film | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive |
| Topical fluoride | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive |
| Sealant | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive | Preventive |
| Amalgam filling | Not covered | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Tooth-colored filling, back tooth (posterior composite) | Not covered | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Tooth-colored filling, front tooth (anterior composite) | Not covered | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Simple extraction | Not covered | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Palliative emergency treatment | Not covered | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Root canal (endodontic therapy) | Not covered | Basic | Major | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Scaling and root planing | Not covered | Basic | Major | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Periodontal maintenance | Not covered | Basic | Major | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Surgical extraction | Not covered | Basic | Major | Basic | Basic | Basic |
| Crown | Not covered | Not covered | Major | Major | Major | Major |
| Fixed bridge | Not covered | Not covered | Major | Major | Major | Major |
| Denture | Not covered | Not covered | Major | Major | Major | Major |
| Implant | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Major | Major | Major |
| Cosmetic or other services | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered |

### Notes on the schedule
- Classic 1250 is the only plan that places root canals, scaling and root planing, periodontal maintenance and surgical extractions in the major class; the other plans that cover them place them in the basic class.
- Implants are covered (major class) only on Plus 1500, Premier 2000 and Elite 2500.
- Cosmetic or other services are not covered on any plan.
